senses.gloss: (= כְּאִילּוּ אָמַר) as though one said, that is to say, this means.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 2:3">Naz. II, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Nazir 11a:1">11ᵃ</cite>) <he>לא נתכוונה זו אלא כ׳ וכ׳</he> (Mish. ed. <he>לומר</he>) she had no intention except that of one who says, ‘This be unto me a sacrifice’, i.e. she meant only to forbid herself this cup (cmp.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Snh. VI, 4</cite> (interpret. <he>כי קללת וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:23">Deut. XXI, 23</cite>) <he>כ׳ מפני מה וכ׳</he> which means as much as, (people will say,) Why has this man been hanged? &c.—Ib. 6 <he>כ׳ שאין וכ׳</he> as if saying (intimating), we bear no grudge &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41:5">Ex. R. s. 41</cite> <he>היא מגלה פניה כ׳ וכ׳</he> she uncovers her face, as if saying &c.; a. v. fr.
